# agent-workspace-kit: the doc map for agents

## This repo

- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): the numbered path from
  nothing to a validated team and a generated layout, all commands
  copy-pasteable.
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): day-to-day operation, grouped by
  task: adding roles, selecting and resetting lanes, sentinels, running
  without panes, mounting as `ecp team`.
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): the operator's reference: the full
  command surface, every manifest key, every error string with its fix,
  recovery procedures.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the boundary as rules an agent obeys.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, the prose gate, the
  change bar.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting, scope.
- skills/agent-workspace-kit/SKILL.md: the skill form of the boundary.
- [examples/run-demo.sh](examples/run-demo.sh): the runnable example
  (validates the demo team and prints its layouts; output captured in
  [examples/README.md](examples/README.md)).

## The family (AI ECP)

- the family catalog (the map home; in the private control-plane repo).
- repo-guards: governance kit (gates, hooks, CI shape).
- actions-runner: the deterministic agent-pipeline runner.
- omp-rpc-cli: persistent omp RPC sessions (the mode A half; this kit is
  the mode B half; each can use the other).
- ecp-toolkit: the control plane CLI.
- docs-policy-kit, op-safe: docs and secrets kits.
- The family's documentation standard (in the private control-plane repo).
- The agent-team subsystem design this kit implements (in the private
  control-plane repo).
- pi-link: the multi-terminal coordination dependency (its own repo; its
  --team-check rules are the manifest contract this kit mirrors).

Verified 2026-10-22.
